steps.content: You burst into the Black Ring. It's like plunging headlong into a raging river; you are immediately drowning in concentrated Mania.
The current fights you, pushing back against your very presence. And through the roaring torrent—amid the countless voices of resentment, hatred, obsession, and joy—you hear a familiar one.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're here.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why are you here?

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'm here for Hella. Give her back to me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Am I not Hella?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh... so that's how it is... To you, we're nothing like her. We're just dead and gone.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Only she deserves to live.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Don't try that guilt trip on me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look at what you've done to her! To all those innocent people! You don't even think humans deserve to live, so why should I treat you like one? You're a monster, just like the ones you hate!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't you dare come to me wearing her face. You have nothing in common with the real Hella!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You never even considered yourself human, did you? How else could you kill so many without feeling a thing? You even hurt her, an innocent person who only wanted to help you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop the act! You never saw her as one of your own. You're different, right down to your core!
It listens, silent and still. Then, a smile splits its face.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yes... We do feel it that way.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: As someone from DisCity... as a Sinner... she has a place to return to. She is... not like us.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...But Hella didn't see it that way.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She said we weren't so different. Equally weak. Equally powerless... just struggling to get by.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We all watch the strong defy their fate and charge ahead... while we're left secretly hoping...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: "Turn around. See me. Look at me... save me..."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The weak are all the same.
Its voice softens, like a longing unearthed from forgotten years, tender and aching.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That's what she believed. It's why she brought us... all this way... to find you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She thought you could save us...
It fixes its gaze upon you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But you don't want to.
It closes in on you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You've become just like the others. No different from the ones who terrified her...
Then, countless clones of it materialize, swarming around you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So, you can no longer take her away...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mmph!

The shackles seep out, merging with it, with them, all while an eerie laughter rings in your ears. Meanwhile, the Mania within you decomposes your very being, melting you down to feed upon your essence.

A blue light flashes—the <color=#fb9259>insurance</color> Schorl promised. Though instantly engulfed by the maelstrom, it rips a tiny seam in reality. It's all the opening you need, and you seize it without a second thought.

You lunge for the phantom closest to her. You know, with every fiber of your being, that the "Hella" who came for you isn't just another of the Black Ring's deceptions. You trust that somewhere within that phantom, buried deep in the shadows, her true heart still exists.
You believe the real Hella is right here, and you can reach her. You just have to trust your instincts!
[Release the shackles]

steps.speaker: Black Ring Phantom
steps.content: AAAHHHHH!!!!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: HELLA!!!
The shackles lunge forward, unerringly aimed at the only shadow that weeps. It shatters above you like glass, and with its destruction, a massive fissure tears open the blood-red sky.
Then, the sky transforms. A waterfall of crimson pours through the rupture—a mighty river roaring down with the singular intent to drag you into the abyss.
The Observatorium's blue light envelopes you, shielding you once more, but its flickering glow is clearly reaching its limit. Urgent warnings scream in your mind: Leave. Now.
[Screen Flash] Red Shackles Effect
It worked!

The other end of the shackles goes taut, snagged on something solid. Obeying your will, they violently yank you upward, against the falling torrent. Countless vengeful spirits shriek and rush at your face; malevolent winds slice at your body like steel blades. Yet you clutch the shackles, struggling forward, desperate for a glimpse of the path ahead.

Can you even see? Your vision is a smear of blood. Yet fragments from the crimson torrent splash onto your cheeks and hands. They vanish instantly, but each one sears your skin like white-hot embers, branding you with their memory.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella! Damn it... Get back here!!
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: So thank you, Hella... For giving us hope.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hella is the best girl in the world, the toughest little mouse. No one can say otherwise.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Thank you. You not only saved my life, but the lives of everyone in Furor as well. I'm truly in your debt.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: No matter where they are, rats always find a way to survive. No masters, no chains—just pure, stubborn aliveness. They're free, and I like that about them.
[Flashback]
Another phantom emerges ahead, a solitary figure resisting the relentless current.

Unlike the others, she stands isolated within the torrent's heart, battered and devoured by its fury—struggling forward in vain, just like you. Is she crying? The image sharpens, and the sight of her lances through your heart. You scream her name, the sound tearing from your throat—
Your left hand reaches forward. Potestas erupts from your palm, and you unleash its full power, violently harnessing the Black Ring's own contamination to blast a path ahead.
It tears open another bloody wound.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Phantom
steps.content: So this is the shackles... This is ███...

steps.speaker: Black Ring Phantom
steps.content: What do you want? To devour us? To pass judgment? With all your power and your flawless nobility?

steps.speaker: Black Ring Phantom
steps.content: <size=52>Then bring it on!!</size> We don't regret a thing! And we're not afraid of your judgment!

steps.speaker: Black Ring Phantom
steps.content: The seeds we planted will break through the earth! This barren land where we fell will live again! We chose this hell! We sacrificed our future to get here, and this is where we make our stand! DisCity, Fraser, shackles, Corpus... no power, no fate, will ever make us kneel!

steps.speaker: Black Ring Phantom
steps.content: This is what Hella gave us! What <color=#7683a2>you</color> taught us!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't do this...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: NOOOOOOOO!!!!!

steps.speaker: Black Ring Phantom
steps.content: We don't care about your conflicts or your causes. We... only have one wish!

The shackles respond with violent agony, as if your very blood vessels have transformed into jagged spikes, ripping through your body to thrust forward. At last, you shatter the "wall" that stood in your way. The world gives way, and you are hurled into a void, utterly untethered, floating weightlessly through the chaos.
Until you crash hard onto solid ground.

In that moment of shocking clarity, you finally realize the truth. You were never ascending. You have been plummeting downward the entire time, surrounded by the swirling fragments of your own torn flesh and blood.

Miraculously, your consciousness holds. A strange, silk-like substance settles over you—gossamer threads light as a cicada's wings, yet their accumulated weight feels suffocating. They extend from your body, not restraining you, but pointing the way forward like a lifeline into the darkness.
With every ounce of strength you have left, you force yourself to stand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look, I don't know you. I don't understand you, and I can never forgive you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I know Hella.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She fought with everything she had to get to you. She let herself be trapped in a Black Ring and endured all this without giving up... She must have had a goal. It can't be despair—Hella would never surrender to Mania... She had to have another wish... And I know the same is true for all of you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The "Hella" who came to me wasn't just her... it was all of you, too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If surrendering to Mania and becoming a Black Ring still wasn't enough... then what is it? What do you want from me by following her all the way here? Tell me...
No one answers. The spirits dissolve into the void, abandoning you to the profound depths of the Black Ring. A place of unsettling, unnatural silence.
Yet, a path remains. The gossamer threads stretch taut, pointing toward a solitary light in the immense distance. And within that light's core, a figure waits.
You move forward, step by arduous step. And then, faintly at first, you hear a familiar voice.
[Fade In Transition] 3s, Heartbeat Sound
[Illusion]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmm... was it a dream...?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You were in my dream again...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, you big dummy...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: While I was away, I had this... really long dream. Like, I was on this adventure, but on my way back... I fell into this river...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The current was so strong... I couldn't even stand straight... Everyone around me was getting swept away... and I couldn't grab onto any of them...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then I realized, hehe... I was gone too...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I was so scared... I couldn't breathe...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: All I could do was scream your name... hoping you'd hear me and come...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hella, wake up...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'm here, Hella. Wake up...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But then I actually saw you... and I realized...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It was just a dream...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha... even in my dreams, I'm so weak. Can't do anything right...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I really tried to change. I gave it everything I had. I just... wanted to catch up...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tell me... what I should do...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: To be like you...
What I couldn't do... I know you can...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... this is what she wanted...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Trapped in all that Mania... crossing all those catastrophes... fighting an endless corruption with nothing but a limited ability to heal herself. Even after merging with a Black Ring that big... she still fought her way back across thousands of miles...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...All just to come home to you. That was her only wish.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can do this. Of course you can...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just keep going. One more step. Then another...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That kid never stopped waiting for you. She never lost faith...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So for her sake, you must...

You can advance no further. You are utterly enveloped, trapped within the layers of a suffocating cocoon. You cannot take another step. You cannot see what lies ahead. Your body is broken; your spirit, drained. She stands right before your eyes—so close you could almost touch her—yet an impossible chasm separates you.
At the very end... is there anything left to hear?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I take you to the front lines, and let you give everything you have to save this person you care for. And you do. You push beyond your limits. You leave nothing on the field—but you still fail.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...What would you do then?
In the end... Just as she said...
You really have failed this time...
[Hold] 2s
[Scene Change] Exterior Battlefield
(Hecate falls from the giant beast)

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Mmph...!
Razor-sharp spikes punch through Hecate's body, violently tearing through Nightmare. She stumbles, her footing lost, and begins to fall.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Whoops! That was a close one, darling. Tsk, tsk, so careless. You'd have taken quite a spill if I hadn't been here to catch you. Gave you a fright?

In a flash, Synex's tail whips out, hooking around Hecate's waist and yanking her close. Synex opens her mouth to tease, but the words die on her lips. The contamination seeping from the DisCity girl is a torrent—far too much to be explained by a mere fear of falling.
Hecate trembles uncontrollably in her grasp as the contamination visibly spreads across her body. Synex's senses flare; the scent has fundamentally changed.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No... Hella, Chief...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...Don't tell me...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Damn it— Argh!!
She turns to flee to safety, but the ground beneath her feet convulses. She is violently hurled into the air.

Below, the massive metal hammer—the ruined Nirvana Port once driven firmly into the earth—is now being forced upward. Under immense pressure, the Black Ring Apostle begins to rise, its form pulsing and swelling. Vile red markings spread across its surface like cracks, glowing with pent-up energy, charging for a single, catastrophic purpose.
With a final, tectonic heave, it unleashes its power—

steps.speaker: Black Ring Apostle
steps.content: ROAAAAR!!!

Selyna can barely contain her exhilaration. The strategy worked! The Aurum Secretum sorcerers have successfully locked the DisCity Shepherd in the Black Ring's depths, severing all external links. Both the Shepherd and his shackles are now imprisoned. Now, all that remains is for the Ring to consume him utterly.
steps.female_content: Selyna can barely contain her exhilaration. The strategy worked! The Aurum Secretum sorcerers have successfully locked the DisCity Shepherd in the Black Ring's depths, severing all external links. Both the Shepherd and her shackles are now imprisoned. Now, all that remains is for the Ring to consume her utterly.

steps.content: They will possess the most powerful Black Ring in history!! They've won. They've truly w—

A searing red light lances through her body. The Apostle Black Ring, having feasted on the shackles, swells with power exactly as she had envisioned. And with that power, it immediately turns and devours her and the nearby Aurum Secretum sorcerers, bringing their exhilaration to an abrupt and absolute end.

The last loyal Aurum Secretum warrior falls, slain by the very god they labored to create. And in her final moment, she dies laughing—a sound of pure, ecstatic contentment, fervently believing in a promised future.

EDGE-07: Unbelievable...
EDGE-07: He was right there! The target was in his sights. How did he still manage to fail?!

EDGE-02: Maybe the real miracle is that he made it that deep alone in the first place.
steps.female_content:
EDGE-07: Unbelievable...
EDGE-07: She was right there! The target was in her sights. How did she still manage to fail?!

EDGE-02: Maybe the real miracle is that she made it that deep alone in the first place.

steps.content:
EDGE-07: BR-005's Mania is intensifying!! This is... this is an effect we've never seen before!
EDGE-07: The DisSea activities are getting stronger, too. What the hell is going on? Where's 06? Still too busy to check in?!
EDGE-07: Someone get me a status from inside the Ring! Contact the Third Observatorium, now!

EDGE-01: It's regrettable, but a full sanitization is our only option to stop the fusion.

EDGE-05: What's the FAC's estimated hold time?
EDGE-06: As long as we have to. But your clock is ticking faster than ours.

EDGE-05: Then, let's leave it to <color=#dg1f1f>her</color>.
[Scene Change] Battlefield Frontline

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That's the situation as it stands... Please assemble your Rancor forces, General Augustus.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We'll be counting on you for the battle ahead.
